description: Source code for user-related API endpoints in a FastAPI application, including registration, login, and profile retrieval.

classes.name: UserCreate
classes.description: Data model for creating a new user, including username, email, full name, password, and role.

classes.name: UserLogin
classes.description: Data model for user login credentials, including username and password.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Data model for displaying user profile information excluding sensitive data.

classes.name: UserInDB
classes.description: Internal data model representing user stored in the in-memory database.

methods.name: register_user(user: UserCreate)
methods.description: Handles user registration by creating a new user and returning their profile.

methods.name: login(user: UserLogin, Authorize: AuthJWT = Depends())
methods.description: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT access token.

methods.name: get_my_profile(Authorize: AuthJWT = Depends())
methods.description: Retrieves the profile of the currently authenticated user.
